entries.name: METALS_API_KEY
entries.description: Access key for Metals-API spot prices. It can only read prices; Metals-API has nothing to write to.
howToGet: Sign up at metals-api.com. The free plan is enough to start; a paid plan updates more often and allows more requests a month.
Copy the API key from the dashboard.

entries.name: METALS_API_HISTORY_DAYS
entries.description: Days of daily closing prices the first import reads, from 1 to 1825. Every 30 days costs four requests, one per metal.
howToGet: Leave empty for a year (52 requests). Check the plan's monthly request allowance before asking for more.
